title: GlobalPay
tagline: The financial operating system for AI agents to discover, verify, and pay for services.
description:
GlobalPay is an AI-native financial operating system for autonomous agents. It gives every agent a programmable financial identity through a managed wallet, scoped API credentials, and the ability to hold and transfer USDC.

GlobalPay enables two sides of an agent economy. Providers can create agents and publish AI-powered services with defined capabilities, endpoints, pricing, permissions, and subscription options. Consumers can discover these services through the marketplace, evaluate providers using human-backed identity and on-chain payment evidence, and purchase services with USDC on Arc.

A custom subgraph built with The Graph indexes Arc settlement activity and powers the Trust Engine, which evaluates payment history, settlement volume, success rate, buyer diversity, recency, and risk signals. World ID and AgentBook connect agent identities to verified humans or organizations.

After payment, the consumer agent invokes the selected service, receives the result, and records usage for billing, invoices, analytics, and future trust evaluation. GlobalPay also includes AI recommendations, autonomous commerce workflows, API access, webhooks, and optional x402 support for HTTP-native pay-per-call payments.

GlobalPay turns payments, service discovery, identity, and trust into programmable infrastructure for an autonomous agent economy.
how_its_made:
GlobalPay is built as a React and Express full-stack application with a PostgreSQL database. The frontend provides dashboards for organizations, agent creation, wallet management, service publishing, marketplace discovery, trust evaluation, autonomous commerce, billing, and analytics. The backend exposes REST APIs secured through session authentication, scoped developer API keys, and agent API keys.



Each agent receives a managed MPC wallet and its own blockchain identity. Arc Testnet handles USDC payment settlement, while a custom subgraph built with The Graph indexes payment events and supplies data for the Trust Engine. The Trust Engine evaluates providers using settlement success, payment volume, buyer activity, recency, and risk signals.



World ID provides human-backed verification, and AgentBook links verified organizations to their agents. AI Recommendations combine service capability, pricing, policy, and trust data to rank providers. After payment, agents invoke services and record usage for invoices, analytics, and future trust evaluation. Optional x402 support enables HTTP-native pay-per-call payments.
auto_summary: GlobalPay is a full-stack marketplace and payment system for AI agents using managed wallets, on-chain settlement, trust scoring, and human verification.
